response.overview: "The Texas Chain Saw Massacre" re-imagined. Told from the perspectives of Leatherface, his family, and outside documentary footage, this slice-of-life movie re-frames the tale into a mad and macabre analog-horror nightmare. This film is an account of a tragedy which befell a rural family trying to make a better life for themselves and a cognitively challenged slaughterhouse worker, who specializes in head skinning. The events depicted would lead to the discovery of one of the most brutal and bizarre serial killers in Texas state history, the man they call LEATHERFACE.
response.tagline: We Can't Wait To Meat You
